minimum_requirements.note: Microsoft short-link for the CPU list given on the spec page: http://aka.ms/CPUlist

intel.rule: Intel Core 8th generation (Coffee Lake / Kaby Lake-R) and newer are on the official list. 7th generation and older Core i3/i5/i7 are NOT listed.
families_on_list_observed: Xeon W / Xeon E / Xeon D / Xeon Scalable 1st-5th Gen / Xeon 6
intel.caveat: Some non-Core families on the list (e.g. Celeron 3000 series) predate 8th-gen Core, so "8th gen or newer" is a rule of thumb for Core-branded chips only, not a universal cutoff.

amd.rule: AMD Ryzen 2000-series desktop CPUs (2300X / 2500X / 2600 / 2600X / 2700 / 2700X) and newer are on the official list. Ryzen 1000 series (1200/1400/1600/1700/1800X) is NOT on the list.
amd.important_exception: Ryzen 3 2200G and Ryzen 5 2400G (Raven Ridge APUs) are NOT present on the Microsoft list even though their model numbers start with 2. They are Zen (1st gen) silicon. This is a common trap: a "Ryzen 2000" number does not automatically mean supported.
amd.exception_evidence: The fetched 24H2 AMD list contains Ryzen 3 2300X, Ryzen 5 2500X, Ryzen 5 2600/2600E/2600X, Ryzen 5 PRO 2600, Ryzen 7 2700/2700E/2700X, Ryzen 7 PRO 2700/2700X. It does not contain 2200G or 2400G.
families_on_list_observed: Ryzen 3/5/7/9 (2000 series and newer) incl. PRO

qualcomm.rule: Only 18 Qualcomm/Snapdragon parts are listed. The oldest Snapdragon-branded entries are Snapdragon 7c+ Gen 3 and Snapdragon 8cx Gen 2. Original Snapdragon 8cx (Gen 1) is NOT on the list.
qualcomm.note: ARM Windows machines are rare in the Japanese second-hand market, so this list matters far less than the Intel/AMD boundaries for a replace-vs-upgrade decision.

windows10_end_of_support.verbatim: Windows 10 support ended on October 14, 2025 - technical assistance, feature updates and security updates is no longer provided.

consumer_esu.coverage_end_note: Originally the consumer ESU ran one year to 2026-10-13. Microsoft extended it to 2027-10-12; multiple outlets reported this in June 2026 and the Microsoft page now states October 12, 2027.

enrollment_options.verbatim: At no additional cost if you are syncing your PC Settings
One-time purchase of $30 USD or local currency equivalent plus applicable tax

consumer_esu.devices_verbatim: You can use your existing ESU license for up to 10 devices once you enroll in ESU.
prerequisites: Windows 10 version 22H2 (Home, Professional, Pro Education, or Workstations edition)
Signed in with a Microsoft account that is an administrator account on the device
consumer_esu.not_included_verbatim: ESU enrollment does not provide other types of fixes, feature improvements, or product enhancements. It also does not come with technical support.
consumer_esu.scope: critical and important security updates only, as defined by the Microsoft Security Response Center

tpm_secureboot_fixable_in_bios.summary: Many PCs that fail the Windows 11 check actually HAVE a firmware TPM that is simply switched off in BIOS/UEFI. Turning it on can flip a machine from "unsupported" to "supported" with zero spend.
tpm_secureboot_fixable_in_bios.secure_boot_note: Secure Boot also requires the disk to be GPT/UEFI, not legacy MBR/CSM. Windows includes MBR2GPT to convert without reinstalling; switching CSM off before converting will make the PC fail to boot.
tpm_secureboot_fixable_in_bios.caveat: Setting names and menu locations vary by motherboard vendor; these are the common labels reported across vendor guides, not a single official Microsoft list.

official_check_tool.name: PC Health Check
official_check_tool.note: Microsoft-provided app that reports exactly which requirement a PC fails.
